connector.name: Product Source
connector.registryDescription: Real-time product data across 450+ retailers - look up any UPC for prices, images, and margin data.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.productsource.io over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace io.productsource. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token API key. Get one free at https://productsource.io
